title: BiaSWE: An Expert Annotated Dataset for Misogyny Detection in Swedish

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of an expert-annotated dataset (BiaSWE) of Swedish internet forum posts, evaluating texts for misogyny through a multi-step annotation process. This includes binary classification of misogyny, categorization into five specific types (stereotype, erasure and minimization, violence against women, sexualisation and objectification, anti-feminism), and a severity rating on a 1 to 10 scale.
Binary classification by expert annotators to identify the general presence of any type of hate speech or hateful behavior in the collected forum posts.
